goal: Build and offline-verify a finite dual-bank connector capture executor that preserves raw failure evidence before parsing; authenticated execution remains separately gated.

pre_implementation.goal: Build and offline-verify a finite dual-bank connector capture executor that preserves raw failure evidence before parsing; authenticated execution remains separately gated.
todo: Implement strict frozen enrollment validation and the sequential 58-request-per-bank operation graph using the unchanged provider-bound source client.
Implement a cancellable streaming transport with fixed request/page/rate/byte/time budgets, no retries or redirects, and raw response capture before validation.
Implement private append-only attempt/raw-inventory and failure outcomes with fixed denominators, quarantine handling and an allowlisted public summary.
Prove all limits and failure retention offline with inert credentials and fake transport/socketpair tests; independently review the exact implementation SHA before any later enrolled execution gate.

Plan docs/superpowers/plans/2026-11-05-bank-canary-capture-executor.md; spec docs/agents/specs/2026-11-05-bank-canary-capture-executor.md; record docs/agents/records/2026-11-05-bank-canary-capture-executor.json. No bank execution authority. Exact gate SHA follows checkpoint push.

forbidden_scope: Authenticated provider calls or reading actual credential material
Changing existing source client or production application behavior
Dependencies, compose/CI, policy, merge, deploy, cutover or release acceptance
acceptance_tests: Offline maximum graph is exactly 58 requests per bank/116 total with only one approved resolution POST per bank.
Attempted page 11, request 59, response/aggregate overflow, slow trickle, blocked connect, cancellation and cleanup obey hard bounds.
All rejected/non-200/partial/HTTP-error/parser-error bytes are inventoried before validation; absent and truncated evidence never passes.
Wrong bank/selector/region/revision/membership, null terminal cursor, missing enrollment and secret-bearing outputs fail closed without retries or leakage.
